notes.title: ENTERING STEAM BASH BASH!
notes.content:
[b]So, after 2 months of 'crunch time' I'm happy to give you a fresh update! With better graphics and a lot of new features![/b]

Also this update comes to celebrate the upcoming steam BashBash event and I am super happy to be invited to participate!

However the last days/weeks have been ultra stressful and I'm not 100% happy with the current state of the game so I'll continue to update this game during the event. (It's cool, I just wanted more...)

I hope you all enjoy it anyway and I'll post more news about the event soon!
Now I have to update the trailer and screenshots.

Here a short list of changes:
[list]
[*] Upscaled ALL graphics to HD ... this was a big one!
[*] Added the start of the story mode (And I finally have the rest of the story sorted).
[*] Added BashBash mode, inspired by the steam event I think I'll make this part of the final game too!
[*] Reworked the combat mechanics and AI.
[*] No more stick! The Sling does all the combat now, close up and ranged!
[*] New melee combos, you can charge the melee by holding it or hit with the right timing.
[*] Added some music and working on more.
[*] Added a few more sound effects, more to come!
[*] Made the main menu nice and cozy... I like campfires.
[*] Tons of other stuff, I've kinda reworked the whole game
[/list]

As always, please let me know what you think!

And please ADD THIS GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST to get notified when it releases! 

Best regards,
James

notes.title: UPDATE v0.07
notes.content:
I'm currently forced to ice the development on this until I've recovered financially but I'll be looking forward to finishing this game sometime in the next few years. I may however find some time inbetween to make small steps and hope that you are all still around then!

Anyway, here for you to play with...

[u]List of changes:[/u]
[list]
[*]reworked menus
[*]added custom options to launching play session (Seed, Location and Size)
[*]added 3 new jump skills (Bear Trap, Xplosion Trap, Corpse Xplosion (reworked)
[*]Fine tuned melee combos
[*]...and other stuff I forgot
[/list]

Have fun and let me know what you think!

-James

notes.title: UPDATE v0.05
notes.content:
[b]Here's the next update to Temple Of Rust!

HELLO TO YOU ALL!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700366/81f80655702bb0d103ff472c7b556ec9659608c3.gif[/img]
AND THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING THIS GAME![/b]

The weather is pretty cloudy here lateley so I'm working on battery limits and that is slowing me down a bit. Anyway I have added a few things and started a lot of 'background - construction' work for the data structures that form the game levels. The GritCity got a new mission goal and wall variations. 
I've also been working on a Level Editor for ENYO Arcade and am trying to think of some cool ways to maybe integrate Steam Workshop features in both games.

[u]List of changes:[/u]
[list]
[*]optimized/cleaned up location creation code
[*]added new zone chunks to gritcity
[*]added more variation to gritcity walls
[*]added new mission goal in gritcity
[*]started to work on editor tools
[*]...and other stuff I forgot
[/list]

Still: For the next update I want to further develop the later environments and building up some 'endgame' content so I can balance the Items and difficulty for the final stages a bit. So I'll be making a lot of graphics...

Have fun! And if YOU think you might be interested in a level editor or other workshop features then let me know! 

-James

notes.title: UPDATE v0.04
notes.content:
[b]Here's the 2nd update to Temple Of Rust!

HELLO TO ALL YOU PLAYERS!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700366/f78e6422c7ea060d439c1c4b578558f407c844be.gif[/img]
THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING THIS GAME![/b]

I've focused on optimizing the render pipeline. I've tested a few options on how to sort the moving objects depth to keep the illusion of a 3D world.
Objects off screen now become inactive or invisible to open up more performance for other stuff. And I've started to link a lot of parameters to internal 'global settings' so I can balance the damage and health ratios later.

The caves got a new mission goal and light-bugs (not errors but bugs...) and I've started to set up the story with the new starting location.


[u]List of changes:[/u]
[list]
[*]reworked z-sorting
[*]offscreen objects now deactivate or set invisible
[*]added different start location
[*]added new mission goal in caves
[*]done some finetuning on all the AI's health/damage
[*]...and other stuff I forgot
[/list]

For the next update I want to *still* further develop the later environments and building up some 'endgame' content so I can balance the Items and difficulty for the final stages a bit.

Let me know if you run into any trouble with the game!

-James

notes.title: UPDATE v0.03
notes.content:
[b]Here's the first (of plenty to come) update to Temple Of Rust. But first: 

HELLO TO ALL YOU PLAYERS!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25700366/db2cfe35c7cf4578045bb5316618718c4c0e8dd7.gif[/img]
THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING THIS GAME![/b]

I've been waiting for YoYo Games to update GM2 (the engine/framework that I'm using to create this game) and now that they fixed the 3D Audio on their side the audio FX should fade out in the distance again. Aside from that I'm starting to work on the next environments and tweaking what I find on the way.

[u]List of changes:[/u]
[list]
[*]3D Audio falloff fixed
[*]new tilemaps and trees for trashfield environment
[*]new sling ammo: JigSawBlades and ProximityGrenades
[*]pickups now drop the previous pickup to swap
[*]done some finetuning on all the AI's attack distances
[*]Added build info to the main menu screen
[*]speeded up the sling's loadup animation so it can fire faster
[*]...and other stuff I forgot
[/list]

For the next update I want to further develop the later environments and building up some 'endgame' content so I can balance the Items and difficulty for the final stages a bit.

Let me know if you run into any trouble with the game!

-James
